subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should active session goals be injected into every non-paused agent turn as bounded user-role context, with QA coverage for normal turns, post-compaction turns, and later-turn followthrough?
rationale: This changes prompt behavior for all active `/goal` sessions and touches session-state/context semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without owner intent.

options.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
options.body: Land the per-turn active-goal context design after the linked PR fixes current-turn-only stripping/replay behavior and default turn delivery.

options.title: QA-only first
options.body: Add scenarios that expose the current continuance gap before deciding whether automatic active-goal context is the right product behavior.

options.title: Defer continuance
options.body: Keep goals as explicit `/goal` and tool state for now, accepting that later turns may need user nudges.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
recommendation.body: Land the per-turn active-goal context design after the linked PR fixes current-turn-only stripping/replay behavior and default turn delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened this product follow-up and authored the linked candidate implementation.
